dc:title: Daily Wholesale Mandi Market Prices of Agricultural Commodities by Variety
dcterms:abstract: The data refers to prices of variety wise agricultural commodities. It has the wholesale maximum price, minimum price and modal price on daily basis.
dc:description: The data refers to prices of variety wise agricultural commodities. It has the wholesale maximum price, minimum price and modal price on daily basis. The data refers to the wholesale (Mandi) prices and not the retail prices. The market prices are filtered by state, district, agricultural commodity type and variety of the agricultural commodity. There might be cases where some commodities are not traded on certain days in a market.
dcin:note: The mandi prices are at wholesale level filtered by state, districts and agricultural commodity type.
